==English==
{{wp}}
{{commonscat|Lesbians}}
[[file:Double Venus symbol.svg|thumb|The symbol for a lesbian union]]

===Alternative forms===
* {{alt|en|le$bian|le dollar bean|les🫘}}

===Etymology===
{{ety|en|id=Lesbos}}
From {{der|en|la|Lesbiana}}, from {{der|en|grc|Λέσβος}} + Latin adjective suffix {{m|la|-iana}}; by reference to [[w:Sappho|Sappho]] of [[Lesbos]] (whence also {{m|en|sapphist}}, {{m|en|sapphic}}), known for her sentimental poems about women. This sense of the word may have been borrowed from, or influenced by, the German cognate {{m|de|lesbisch}}, where it is found in medical literature from the 1830s.

===Pronunciation===
* {{IPA|en|/ˈlɛz.bi.ən/|a=RP,GA}}
* {{audio|en|En-us-lesbian.wav|a=GA}}
* {{rhymes|en|ɛzbiən|s=3}}
* {{hyphenation|en|lesb|i|an}}

===Adjective===
{{en-adj}}

# {{sid|en|homosexual}} {{lb|en|of a woman}} {{cap|homosexual}}, [[gay]]; [[prefer]]ring [[exclusively]] [[woman|women]] as [[romantic]] or [[sexual]] [[partner]]s.
#: {{cot|en|sapphic}}
#: {{ux|en|'''Lesbian''' fans of the show were rooting for Jane and Amanda to get together.}}
## {{sid|en|preferring women romantically}} {{lb|en|of a woman|broadly}} [[prefer|Preferring]] [[primarily]] [[women]] as [[romantic]] or [[sexual]] [[partner]]s.
# {{sid|en|of a relationship}} {{lb|en|of a romantic or sexual act or relationship}} Between two or more women; [[homosexual]], [[gay]].
#: {{ux|en|a '''lesbian''' relationship / marriage / kiss}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1855|editor=|tlr=Charles Hempel|title=Homœopathic guide in all diseases of the Urinary and Sexual Organs
|pageurl=https://archive.org/stream/homopathicguidei00goll#page/200/mode/2up
|publisher=Rademacher & Sheek|location=Philadelphia|isbn=|page=201
|passage=The so-termed '''Lesbian''' love is a vice of a still more hideous and degrading nature than pederasty.
|original=Der homöopathische Rathgeber: in allen Krankheiten der Geschlechts- und Harnwerkzeuge
|by=Wilhelm Gollmann|origyear=1854}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2011|author=Michael Bruce; Robert M. Stewart|title=College Sex - Philosophy for Everyone|isbn=1444341448|page=32
|passage={{...}} Madonna's infamous nationally televised '''lesbian''' kiss with Britney Spears {{...}}}}
# {{sid|en|of a group}} {{lb|en|especially of an institution or group}} Intended for [[#Noun|lesbian]]s.
#: {{ux|en|We're going to a '''lesbian''' bar tonight.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2000|author=Bonnie Zimmerman|title=Encyclopedia of '''lesbian''' and gay histories and cultures|volume=1|page=135
|passage=Some lesbians also felt comfortable in the entertainment clubs in the black section of the city; these clubs were not '''lesbian''' but were lesbian friendly.}}
# {{sid|en|of Lesbos}} {{lb|en|now|rare}} {{alt case form|en|Lesbian||of or pertaining to the island of [[Lesbos]]}}.

===Noun===
{{en-noun}}

# {{sid|en|homosexual woman}} A [[homosexual]] [[woman]], a woman who is exclusively sexually and/or romantically attracted to other women.
#: {{syn|en|Thesaurus:gay woman}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1904|author=Jacobus X|title=Crossways of Sex: A Study in Eroto-pathology|volume=1|page=2
|passage=There have also been women who loved other women. These are the '''''Lesbians''''' or ''Tribades''.}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2020|author=Ana Patrícia Hilário; Fábio Rafael Augusto|title=Practical and Ethical Dilemmas in Researching Sensitive Topics with Populations Considered Vulnerable|page=91
|passage=Another Spanish-speaking respondent said that she does not identify as a '''lesbian''' because that is a term for women who like women, and as she does not like women, and so she cannot be a '''lesbian'''.}}
#* {{see more citations|en}}
# {{sid|en|animal}} {{lb|en|uncommon}} A [[female]] animal that performs courtship, pairing or mating behavior with other female animals.
#* {{quote-book|en|year=1979|author=Terry Hekker|title=Ever Since Adam and Eve|location=New York|publisher=Morrow
|passage=There was one recently that determined on an island off California 14 percent of the female sea gulls were '''lesbians''' (and we know that kind of thing would never go among Nantucket sea gulls).}}
#* {{quote-book|en|year=2014|author=George H Harrison|title=Birds Do It, Too: The Amazing Sex Life of Birds|publisher=Willow Creek Press|isbn=9781623435950
|passage=The only between this pair and others in the community is that they are among the 8 to 14 percent of the residents that are '''lesbians'''. After building their nest, the pair, two female western gulls, customarily produce twice as many eggs {{...}}}}
# {{sid|en|inhabitant of Lesbos}} {{lb|en|now|rare}} {{alt case form|en|Lesbian||native or inhabitant of Lesbos.}}.

====Usage notes====
* Many dictionaries define ''lesbian'' simply as a woman who is sexually (or romantically<ref name="MWO"/><ref name="OED"/>) attracted to other women.<ref name="MWO">{{R:MWO}}</ref><ref>{{R:Dictionary.com}}</ref><ref>''Pocket Oxford English Dictionary'' ({{ISBN|978-0-19-966615-7}}, 2013), edited by Maurice Waite, page 522</ref><ref>{{R:Cambridge}}</ref><ref>{{R:MacMillan}}</ref> It especially refers to one who is attracted ''mostly'' or ''exclusively'' to other women.<ref name="OED">{{R:New English Dictionary}} [https://www.oed.com/viewdictionaryentry/Entry/107453 online] ("a woman [...] attracted (esp. wholly or largely) to other women")</ref> It is [[Citations:lesbian|sometimes used]] in a way that includes other (e.g. [[bisexual]]) [[WLW|women who love women]], or certain [[non-binary]] people<!--see [[Citations:lesbian]]-->.
